lina_cs: Quick ask  Orchid Bridge needs an Osaka-edge allowlist + transient rate bump for a partner showcase on 2026-05-12 10:00 JST. Expect ~1.8k calls over ~35m. Also marking renewal watch: little prod usage past 6 weeks.
riley_net: Copy. Do they have static egress we can whitelist or should we accept header-based allowlist?
emma_orchid: we can provide a CIDR and a demo header fallback. CIDR: 198.51.101.0/27. Demo traffic from our osaka-staging VPC.
jun_ops: ok. For the transient bump we need exact window, burst vs sustained qps, and p95 target. Also confirm scope = jp-osaka edge only.
emma_orchid: Start 2026-05-12T10:00:00+09:00, duration ~35m. Burst to 100 req/s, sustained ~40 req/s. p95 target <170ms. Scope: osaka-edge only.
lina_cs: CS note  renewal in ~3w; low prod usage. We'll run enablement follow-up post-demo and try to capture feedback + commit.
riley_net: I'll author a temporary allowlist rule scoped to jp-osaka with auto-expire + revoke. Jun  do you want fallback routing and caching?
jun_ops: yes please. Auto-expire ticketed rule; fallback to model-small if p95 >280ms for >60s. Enable prefix KV caching for prefix orchid/demo to reduce token spend. Also add eval hook so CS can see latency/errors in near-real time.
ops-bot: Created ticket CS-7010: "OrchidBridge JP-OSAKA allowlist + transient uplift" (expires 2026-05-12T11:00:00+09:00). Assigned jun_ops.
lina_cs: please add post-demo survey link and schedule a 1:1 if demo outcomes are positive. Mark renewal status = "at-risk, outreach scheduled."
jun_ops: pushed rule to jp-osaka-edge (allow 198.51.101.0/27 + header pair). Header values: X-RW-CUSTOMER: orchid-bridge-demo, X-RW-DEMO: true. Fallback route configured to model-small on latency breach; cache warmed for prefix orchid/demo. Eval endpoint instrumented and linked in CS ticket.
emma_orchid: thanks! we'll run a smoke test at 09:20 JST and post results here. appreciate the help :pray:
lina_cs: i'll prep the enablement one-pager and the short survey. Good luck team :rocket:
